what: UnitedHealth Group is the largest US health insurer (UnitedHealthcare) and owns Optum, which runs clinics, a pharmacy-benefit manager and health-data services.
customers: Employers, individuals, Medicare and Medicaid members, and hospitals and doctors that use Optum services.
money: about a third of revenue and a large share of profit
care delivery (Optum Health), pharmacy benefits (Optum Rx), data and technology (Optum Insight)
moat: Scale in insurance and the integration of insurance, care and pharmacy that few rivals can match.
risks: Medicare Advantage payment changes and investigations
Political pressure on insurers and pharmacy-benefit managers
opportunities: Analysts see about 43% upside from current levels
Optum provides care and pharmacy services that grow independently of insurance margins
Revenue grew about 12% last year and about 11% a year over three years
watch: The medical care ratio and Medicare Advantage Star ratings.
